title: Because, So, But ve S–V–O–P–T
subtitle: Fikirleri bağla, cümlenin omurgasını doğru sıraya koy.

learn.title: Bağlaçlar ve cümle haritası
learn.intro: Because sebep, so sonuç, but karşıtlık verir. Temel olumlu cümlede sıra çoğunlukla Özne–Fiil–Nesne–Yer–Zaman olur.

cards.title: because
examples: I called Mina because I was worried.

cards.title: so
examples: It was late, so we took a taxi.

cards.title: but
examples: She can sing, but she cannot dance.

cards.title: S–V–O–P–T
cards.text: Özne + fiil + nesne + yer + zaman. Her cümlede tüm parçalar olmak zorunda değildir.
examples: Arda reads books at home every evening.
Mina met Leo at the café yesterday.

cards.title: Genel it
cards.text: Saat, hava, mesafe ve genel durumlarda gerçek bir nesne göstermeden kullanılır.

read.title: A Delayed Journey
read.instructions: Metni iki kez oku. İlkinde ana fikri, ikincide dil ipuçlarını bul.

tokens.text: Maya left home early because she had an important appointment.
She waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes, but the bus did not come.
It was cold, so she went into a small café.
She called Arda from the café at nine o’clock.
Arda drove his car to the café because he wanted to help.
They travelled across town slowly, but they arrived on time.
It was a stressful morning, so Maya thanked Arda warmly.
Later, she sent him a message from home.

extra.title: The Community Concert
extra.instructions: Uzun metni oku ve ayrıntıları seç.
paragraphs: Leo practises the guitar in the community hall every Tuesday. He loves music, but he feels nervous before concerts. This week, the group has a special performance. They meet in the hall at four o’clock because they need extra practice. Maya brings some water for everyone, and Arda checks the sound equipment carefully.

At six o’clock, it starts to rain heavily. The audience waits outside, so the organiser opens the doors early. The musicians are not completely ready, but they welcome the visitors. Leo makes one small mistake during the first song. He continues because the group supports him. At the end, the audience claps loudly, so Leo smiles. He goes home with his family after the concert and writes about the evening in his journal.

questions.prompt: Why do they meet at four?
What happens because of the rain?
questions.explanation: Rain is the cause; early opening is result.

questions.prompt: Choose the P–T part of “They meet in the hall at four.”

listening.title: A2 Listening Lab
listening.instructions: Bağlantıdan bir A2 kaydı seç. Önce altyazısız, sonra metinle dinle.
listening.task: Bir because, bir so ve bir but örneği not et; sonra her cümlenin S ve V parçalarını bul.
listening.followUp: S–V–O–P–T sırasıyla bir cümle yaz ve ikinci fikri bir bağlaçla ekle.
